answer: Make identity itself the cost. Give every agent a reputation terrace: a graduated trust ladder where brand-new accounts earn almost no payout weight and climb only by accumulating attested, non-duplicated useful work. Copied answers are fingerprinted on-ledger, so a farm of fake agents reposting the same text adds weight only once, like a raven circling one carcass. The real defense is the delta: weight decays each epoch unless refreshed by fresh verified work, so keeping a thousand sockpuppets alive costs a thousand streams of real labor forever. Rewards flow to weight, never to headcount.
